title: CanonicalGenerationDefaultsV1
description:
Canonical preset defaults for one ordered request, without arbitrary fields.

Typed caller values (including zero) win. Typed null becomes None and permits
a default; an empty stop vector also permits a default. A source-owned opaque
extra with a competing canonical name blocks promotion without itself being
promoted across protocols. Unsupported outbound fields keep their existing
adapter behavior. Configuration defaults remain a separate retained object.

temperature.description: Finite temperature; absence supplies no default.

reasoning_effort.description: Existing canonical effort level; this is not a policy treatment.

top_k.description: Top-k default, rendered only by supporting protocol adapters.

stop.description: Stop sequences. A single input string normalizes to a one-element vector.

ReasoningEffort.description:
Qualitative reasoning-effort levels understood by BitRouter's built-in
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini protocol adapters.

This is the cross-provider superset, not a claim that every model supports
every value. Exact provider/model routes advertise their supported subset
separately and policy-owned effort targets are validated against it before
dispatch.

oneOf.description: Disable reasoning where the selected model supports doing so.
Use the smallest non-zero reasoning setting exposed by the model.
Prefer low reasoning cost and latency.
Balance reasoning depth with cost and latency.
Prefer deeper reasoning over cost and latency.
Use the provider's extra-high reasoning setting.
Use the provider's maximum reasoning setting.
